meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 pandas/NumPy 工作流扩展到集群或超内存数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果现有 pandas 代码因内存不足或数据量过大而无法运行
copy.tagline_en: Scale pandas/NumPy workflows to clusters or out-of-core data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your existing pandas code fails due to memory or data size limits

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Dask 库处理超过内存大小的数据，比如并行读取多个 CSV 文件、进行分组聚合等操作，并支持单机多核或集群分布式计算。
howto.when: 当你需要处理的数据量超过可用内存，或者想加速 pandas/NumPy 操作时，可以要求 Claude 使用 Dask。

say.text: 用 Dask 读取 data 文件夹下所有 CSV 文件并计算每列平均值。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Dask to process datasets larger than RAM, parallelize pandas/NumPy operations, and distribute workloads across multiple cores or machines.
howto.when_en: When you need to process data that exceeds available memory or want to speed up pandas/NumPy operations, you can ask Claude to use Dask.

say_en.text: Use Dask to read all CSV files in the data folder and compute the mean of each column.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and execute Dask DataFrame code.

say_en.text: Help me process these JSON logs in parallel with Dask, filtering for records with status 'valid'.
say_en.note: Claude will use Dask Bag for unstructured data.
